Das ist der Beginn einer breiteren Bewegung, wie wir sie in den USA gesehen haben“, sagt Caro Weber von der Interventionistischen Linken, Sprecherin der Protestaktion. Protest gegen Rechenzentren in Berlin. – : Press release of the protest Activists rallied on Friday afternoon outside two data center campuses in Mariendorf, in the first protest against data centers and AI in Berlin according to the organizers. The sites extending over a former gas plant is fenced, with no sign of life but security personnel and construction workers. The banner held by the activists protesting in front of a windowless building reads “Data centers? No thank you!”  “We are just starting here in Berlin. This is the beginning of a wider movement, like the one we saw in the US,” said Caro Weber from Interventionistische Linke, the spokesperson for the protest. On the cold November afternoon, activists are carrying handwritten signs on cardboard and cloth. Right next to them a police vehicle is standing. The small group has picked a powerful industry to challenge. …
